description: This file defines React components for a UI sheet (drawer) component, utilizing radix-ui primitives. It includes overlay, trigger, close button, header, footer, title, description, and content components with styling and animations.

classes.name: SheetOverlay
classes.description: React component for overlay layer of the sheet with animated fade-in/out.

classes.name: SheetContent
classes.description: Main content component of the sheet with variants for position and animated transition.

classes.name: SheetHeader
classes.description: Component for the header section of the sheet.

classes.name: SheetFooter
classes.description: Component for the footer section of the sheet.

classes.name: SheetTitle
classes.description: Component for the sheet's title text.

classes.name: SheetDescription
classes.description: Component for descriptive text within the sheet.

methods.name: React.forwardRef
methods.description: Utility for creating components that pass refs down to DOM elements.
